subject: Post-demo: Open vs Proprietary parity plan & evaluation asks
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@finovasystems.com>, Jenna Park <jpark@finovasystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + concrete next steps (models to trial, benchmarks, prompt set)

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — great conversation. Quick recap and a concrete proposal for the evaluation sprint so we can validate parity vs your proprietary baseline without disturbing prod.

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary goal: match or beat your baseline on entity extraction and slot-filling for transactional chat flows (loan changes, payment scheduling).
- Constraints: strict PII controls, 100ms-ish target for p50 latency on critical flows, and procurement needs a short pilot SOW.

What we propose to trial (open-model slate):
1) Llama2-Chat-13B (quantized to int8 where helpful) — strong chat capabilities and wide prompt tool support.
2) Mistral-Instruct-7B — good instruction-following and compact footprint.
3) Falcon-40B-Instruct (small-context variant) — higher-capacity test for hard edge cases.

Why this mix: it covers a low-cost small model, a balanced mid-size, and a high-capacity variant so we can map cost/latency/quality tradeoffs. Redwood will handle quantized builds and runtime tuning.

Acceptance thresholds (initial, subject to your input):
- Entity extraction F1 (customer-labeled evaluation set): >= 0.90 vs human labels.
- Intent classification accuracy (top intent): >= 0.92.
- Hallucination / incorrect-information rate: < 2% on evaluation prompts.
- Regression vs your baseline: delta <= 1% absolute on primary metrics.

Artifacts we attached / links: prompt_set_v1.csv (100 canonical prompts + variations), evaluation protocol + spreadsheet: https://drive.redwood/company/finova/DEAL-9423/eval-kit (please confirm access).

Next steps we need from you to start the sprint:
- Share 200 de-identified customer-chat examples (redacted) for a seed evaluation set (we can accept CSV or JSONL).
- Confirm which two flows to prioritize (we suggest: payment-change and early-repayment).
- NDA/test-data addendum for the pilot (we can send a short DocuSign).

Proposed timeline: 1 week to onboard & run initial benchmarks, 1 week A/B blind run vs baseline, then readout. Total 3 weeks to initial decision.

Would love a quick confirmation on the three asks above so we can spin up the trial this week.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
Attachments: prompt_set_v1.csv
From: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@finovasystems.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jpark@finovasystems.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + concrete next steps (models to trial, benchmarks, prompt set)

Appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick questions before we commit the sample data: 

1) Latency: our prod SLO for those flows is p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms. Can you hit p50 ~100ms on any of the suggested models (quantized) when running in your hosted environment?
2) Cost: rough estimated per-1k-token cost for each model (including quantized runtimes) — we need a TCO estimate for the pilot.
3) Baseline: our current proprietary model is a tuned 13B conversational model (in-house), and on our internal test it has 0.93 F1 on entity extraction for the payment-change flow.

We can share de-identified examples but need a short NDA addendum for test data (procurement requirement). Also want to make sure logs we share stay under the data retention policy you outlined in the demo — audits are strict.

If you can answer the latency/cost Qs and share the DocuSign NDA, we can schedule handing over the sample by Tuesday.

—Michael
Michael O'Neil
Head of ML Platforms
Finova Systems
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@finovasystems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + concrete next steps (models to trial, benchmarks, prompt set)

Thanks — good context and helpful to know your baseline numbers. Quick answers and clarifications: 

Latency & deployment modes:
- Hosted (US-west) quantized runtimes: expected p50 (inference only, no network)
  - Llama2-13B int8: ~85–120ms p50 (depends on sequence length; our measurements on 32-token responses)
  - Mistral-7B int8: ~45–70ms p50
  - Falcon-40B (reduced context): ~140–220ms p50 (higher but may beat baseline on hard examples)
- For p95 SLA we recommend the Dedicated plan for production. For the pilot we can run hosted with conservative autoscaling.

Cost (very rough pilot estimate, per 1k tokens served):
- Llama2-13B (quantized): $0.28 / 1k tokens
- Mistral-7B (quantized): $0.14 / 1k tokens
- Falcon-40B (reduced): $0.65 / 1k tokens
(We will provide formal pricing sheet once pilot scope is locked.)

Evaluation protocol:
- We'll run a blind A/B where your current baseline is A and the open-model variants are B(s).
- Primary metrics: entity F1, intent accuracy, user-visible correctness (binary human label).
- Secondary: hallucination rate, latency p50/p95, token cost.

I'll loop in Marissa to own logistics. We'll prepare the NDA DocuSign and an eval spreadsheet template (benchmark_results_template.xlsx).

We can start as soon as you send the de-identified 200 examples and confirm priority flows. Happy to sync for 30m next week to align on labeling protocol.

-Dylan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@finovasystems.com>, Jenna Park <jpark@finovasystems.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + concrete next steps (models to trial, benchmarks, prompt set)

Hey Michael — thanks for the quick reply. Logistically, here's a minimal runway we suggest for a defensible parity decision: 

Pilot scope (2 weeks active testing):
- Week 1: onboarding + baseline run (we put your baseline and the three open models through the prompt_set_v1.csv and your 200 sample set).
- Week 2: blind A/B on an additional 1,000 anonymized interactions routed through both models (we can run via replay for consistency).

Gating / acceptance thresholds (finalized after Week 1 readout):
- Primary: Entity extraction F1 >= 0.90 and within 1% absolute of your baseline (so if baseline 0.93, open model must be >= 0.92).
- Primary: Intent accuracy >= 0.92.
- Safety: Hallucination/incorrect-information rate < 2% on validated prompts.
- Operational: p50 latency <= 140ms for prioritized flows in hosted pilot; if not met we move to Dedicated or quantization changes.
- Regression policy: if any open model underperforms baseline by >2% on primary metrics, stop that variant and fallback to baseline for the pilot.

Attachments: benchmark_results_template.xlsx (empty sheet for your labels + model outputs), prompt_set_v1.csv.

Data/data protection: we will send the NDA addendum today. We do not store raw logs longer than 30 days for pilot; audit logs available on request.

Please confirm: we'll need the 200 de-identified examples and your procurement contact for a short DocuSign SOW (pilot scope + acceptance gates).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: benchmark_results_template.xlsx, prompt_set_v1.csv
From: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@finovasystems.com>

Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + concrete next steps (models to trial, benchmarks, prompt set)

This looks good — we can proceed on the timeline. Action items from our side: 
- Procurement contact: Sara Lin (sara.lin@finovasystems.com) — she'll sign the NDA/SOW via DocuSign; please send the link.
- We'll redact and share the 200 sample rows (CSV) by Tue 2027-03-16 EOD.
- Our baseline numbers: entity F1 0.93 (payment-change), intent acc 0.94. We'll include those in the CSV header.

One ask: can Redwood include an anonymized cost projection for a steady-state production (monthly 2M tokens) for the two most promising models post-pilot? Procurement needs a rough TCO before they sign the pilot SOW.

I'll attach the demo recording for our internal audit (attached). Looking forward to the NDA link.

—Michael
